one_original_writer_actual_segment.charge_contract: One original writer; sum independent actual production load learn save SDKclose childwait and owner terminal receipt.

profile.geometry_adaptation: body-to-wheel 3D lengths from actual MOD4 link poses; tuck .22 SCUT default, extend .31 Fudan target
profile.flight_mask: existing H1 air_ticks>0; measured both-wheel clearance, all34 clearance, nonwheel clean and positive-vz history; no new success threshold
profile.active_scope: H1 public4 request rows with an actual ready attempt; every normal action row retains its original reward

new_source_local_behavior.rate_limit: Read-only formula rates on current local MuJoCo states and actual local actuator force; not a PhysX applied_torque or RewardManager/PPO return. Prior command-only telemetry remains retained.
new_source_local_behavior.interpretation: Use original phase-event counts and late-condition residuals separately: one recovery event does not prove sustained station keeping, statistical success, PhysX qualification or course graduation. Two yaw variants are deterministic small-sample diagnostics under a different backend without original20kDR.

local_events_and_drift.interpretation: Compare each observed event, duration, clearance and late yaw/speed/displacement separately. A sticky recovery event does not establish continuous holding. These are four deterministic local MuJoCo trajectories under a different backend without the production20kDR, not PhysX qualification, statistical significance, unique reward causality or complete normal nonregression.
